prompt_md: Which is correct: "nine plus five is thirteen" or "nine plus five are thirteen"?
prompt_short: "Nine plus five is thirteen" or "are thirteen"?
answer_display: neither: nine plus five is fourteen
hint_md: Check the sum before the grammar.
explain_intuition_md: The question sets you up to argue grammar, so you never check the arithmetic. Nine plus five is fourteen, so both sentences are wrong.
